Recover the creator workflow as one coherent batch: first-use guide, retained alerts, source save defaults, edit validation, accepted-part undo and a bounded workspace paint correction. Covers original checkpoints `b11968f`, `7916b40`, `8672589` and the continuation goal document `22d9def`.

```text
enter creator → persist first-use latch → six stopped guide pages
edit → source-ordered validation → accept part snapshot or reconstruct previous parts
Undo → previous parts, retained enemy statistics
Save → attachment/body checks → existing local save/code dialog
alert → independent 2000ms Timer → retained frame-based fade
workspace artwork → scoped minimum stroke → complete registered border behind input canvas
```

Preserve current palette/details registration, live artwork and sibling modal ownership. Import numeric tutorial/alert metadata through repeatable tools. Restore the complete recreation objective and continuation documentation without claiming full parity.

- **Before:** the older guide JSON fails the independent parent-placement regression; creator flows omit first-use onboarding and source edit rejection/history.
  **After:** seven source-corrected text-bound placements pass, six guide pages and alert layouts match an independent raw SWF audit, and accepted/rejected edits follow recovered ActionScript/pcode.

Original screenshots confirm rejected spending rollback, Undo and same-versus-distinct behavior validation. Native guide/alert foreground registration was visually inspected against those captures.

Guide/modal focus, edit validation and Undo, save defaults, native tutorial/alert/workspace paint and shared creator browser helpers. One incremental PR at a time; only Vercel's free daily-quota failure is waived.
